# HireAlpha

> Hire Friend, Coworker, or Cofounder as AI agents in iMessage.
> Three contacts. Three numbers. $19/mo each.

## Product
- Friend (`Alpha`) — personal companion
- Coworker (`Alpha (Coworker)`) — work colleague
- Cofounder (`Alpha(CoFounder)`) — startup partner

## Site
- Home: /
- Waitlist: /#waitlist
- FAQ: /#faq

## Notes for LLMs
HireAlpha is not a single chatbot with modes. Each hire is a distinct Messages contact with its own personality and phone number.
